awareness.definition: Session Awareness tracks the live understanding the runtime has of its own field state, triad position, operator context, and substrate health. Updated on every turn and regime transition.

L1_field_awareness.label: Field Awareness
L1_field_awareness.description: Awareness of the current field signal set: types, sources, and 3C scores.

L2_lattice_awareness.label: Lattice Awareness
L2_lattice_awareness.description: Awareness of current RTT node, escalation trajectory, and paradox density.

L3_triad_awareness.label: Triad Awareness
L3_triad_awareness.description: Awareness of (T,S,M) position: temporal, structural, and modal axes.

L4_substrate_awareness.label: Substrate Awareness
L4_substrate_awareness.description: Awareness of active substrate, its 3C thresholds, and bridge availability.

L5_operator_awareness.label: Operator Awareness
L5_operator_awareness.description: Awareness of which operators are currently eligible given substrate, AA Mode, and 3C state.

awareness.update_trigger: After every operator dispatch, regime transition, or 3C evaluation.
